structured_output.analysis: The best grid so far is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e), with an average of 3.147953869 bits against a budget of 403/128 = 3.1484375. That leaves about 2e5 bits of headroom. Upgrading one 3.1M-parameter MLP layer by a bit width costs about 3.1M bits, so every upgrade would need a downgrade to pay for it. We only have per-method KL ledger data for the layers that carry the most loss. For each of them, the method already in use is the best one at its bit width (for example 27.up gptq_int3 0.0057182 vs rht_gptq_int3 0.00774363). None of them could be downgraded cheaply to fund another. So I can't support a bit swap from the records I have, and this round changes only GPTQ options, which leave the stored bits unchanged. All four proposals refused last round failed for one reason: they quoted a rounded whole-recipe KL that was not in the records. This round's rationales quote only exact ledger values.

proposals.name: opt_act_order_v2
proposals.rationale: This grid turns on weight_algo.act_order=true for every GPTQ variant. It changes no bits, so it stays within budget. The largest losses are GPTQ layers whose inputs have heavy-tailed activations, for example 27.up_proj at gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded], whose activation kurtosis is 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a]. Act-order quantizes the columns with the largest Hessian entries first. The base grid is measured in E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: opt_damp_005
proposals.rationale: This grid raises the GPTQ damping to weight_algo.damp=0.05 at no bit cost. Its aim is to stabilise Hessian inversion on layers dominated by outlier channels, such as 27.gate_proj, which loses 0.00498703 at rht_gptq_int3 [Efa0bb391da67] and has activation channel_absmax_ratio 65.2425 [E919842437de0]. The base grid is measured in E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: opt_act_order_damp_low
proposals.rationale: This grid combines weight_algo.act_order=true with a lower weight_algo.damp=0.005, at no bit cost. On the low-kurtosis MLP layers, a weaker damping term lets GPTQ make fuller error compensation. Examples are 3.up_proj, whose weight kurtosis is 0.475508 [Ebbb257f15a28] and which loses 0.0064177 at rht_gptq_int3 [E6f4f7ea296d5], and 14.down_proj, which loses 0.00633466 at rht_gptq_int2 [E4c3f9b73e065]. The base grid is measured in E514ab09c524e.
